title: Add support for getting a joypad's battery and connection information

milestone.title: 4.x
milestone.description: Issues and pull requests slated for an undetermined Godot 4 release.

body:
- Closes https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/14482

I decided to split my big SDL3 joypad features PR ( https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/107967 ) into several smaller PRs, this PR is one of them.

This PR adds the ability to get information about the joypad's battery state (no battery, charging, fully charged), battery percentage, connection state (wired, wireless).

Relevant SDL documentation:
[SDL_GetJoystickPowerInfo](https://wiki.libsdl.org/SDL3/SDL_GetJoystickPowerInfo)
[SDL_GetJoystickConnectionState](https://wiki.libsdl.org/SDL3/SDL_GetJoystickConnectionState)

This PR used to have a name `Add support for querying more joypad information`, but was repurposed to `Add support for getting a joypad's battery and connection information` since getting button/axis names and `has_joy_axis/button()` might not be necessary to be builtin in Godot, and `get_joy_model()`, `get_joy_type()` have been moved into a separate PR ( https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/117526 ).
